source: Actual QrBatchGenerator and utility/controller; actual qrcode/JSZip; controlled hook/print/DOM ports, not native browser.

results.name: full actual QR generation enables 2-cell print and honest opened notice
partial generation is never printable and cancelled generation stays absent
editing invalidates print before decode and same-source regeneration cannot revive it
cancel keeps complete images for retry; decode error reports failure
locale ABA invalidates pending work and old rendered action cannot start another print
unmount and Strict effect replay dispose pending print without late dispatch
ZIP retains actual PNGs and filenames and closes its previous print document
